n: Legendary Sican king, ruler of Camicus, whose myth tells that he was protecting Daedalus intent on hiding from the Cretan ruler Minos; this latter will find a violent death in Sicania (present-day Sicily).
Cocytus, a river in the underworld

κωμῳδοποιητής.m: a maker of comedies, comic poet

n: Constantine, a male given name from Latin, particularly (historical) the Roman emperor Constantine the Great
Constantius, a name borne by an Emperor

κωνωπεῖον.m: an Egyptian couch with mosquito-curtains; conopium

κώρα.m: wantonness, wanton violence or insolence; lewdness

κῶρος.m: boy, youth; soldier; son; puppet, doll
